partHeading: PART III. INVESTMENT OF TRUST COMPANY ASSETS
bodyText:
PART III. INVESTMENT OF TRUST COMPANY ASSETS

This part sets forth the requirements and restrictions for investments made by all trust companies. No trust company shall invest its assets except as may be permitted by this part and as may be provided elsewhere in this chapter.
bodyHtml:
PART III.  INVESTMENT OF TRUST COMPANY ASSETS

 

     §412:8-300  Applicability of part.  This part sets forth the requirements and restrictions for investments made by all trust companies.  No trust company shall invest its assets except as may be permitted by this part and as may be provided elsewhere in this chapter. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
